questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?

options.text: A rectangular red sign.
A circular green sign.
A diamond-shaped yellow sign.
A triangular orange sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: A slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. These vehicles drive 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and look in what order?

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars tailgating.
Move when the vehicle ahead of you moves.
Look right first, then left, then right again.
Look left first, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left first, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because vehicles from the left are closer to you. Then look right. Finally, look left again in case you missed a vehicle.

questions.question: Which medications could affect your ability to drive?

options.text: Any medication
Headache medicine
Diet pills
Prescription medication

questions.correctAnswerText: Any medication
questions.explanation: Any medication could affect your driving ability. Ask your doctor or pharmacist about side effects. Read labels on over-the-counter medicines to check if they can impair driving.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look for other vehicles, then go if there is no traffic.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: When driving near children, what should you expect?

options.text: They know when it is safe to cross the street.
They will stop at the curb before crossing.
They may run out in front of you without looking.
They will not cross unless with an adult.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may run out in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Slow down and use extra caution near children. They may not understand danger and could run in front of you without looking.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?

options.text: Red.
Yellow.
Green.
Blue.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow.
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about unexpected road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to all other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to all other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other vehicles go first before you enter the intersection.

questions.question: When does your vehicle need more distance to stop?

options.text: On a wet or icy road.
On paved highways.
When driving at night.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a wet or icy road.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance increases on wet or icy roads. It also increases on loose gravel or stones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot exit the freeway.
You can either continue on or exit the freeway from this lane.
You can stay in this lane and continue through.
You must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in this lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leads off the freeway. You must either change lanes to continue or exit the freeway.

questions.question: What should drivers do in bad weather?

options.text: Drive faster to reach their destination sooner.
Drive closer to other vehicles.
Stay farther away from other vehicles.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from other vehicles.
questions.explanation: In wet weather, increase the distance between your vehicle and others so you have more time to stop.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway and see children playing nearby. What should you do before you move your car?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Sound your horn so the children hear you.
Walk to the back of the car to check that the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of the car to check that the way is clear.
questions.explanation: When you back up, look through your back window for people and objects. Do not rely only on mirrors, especially with children nearby. Always get out of your vehicle and check behind it before you back up.

questions.question: What color are signs for public recreation areas?

options.text: Orange.
Red.
Green.
Brown.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brown.
questions.explanation: Brown signs show cultural sites, historical sites, and public recreation areas. They help you find places when you are traveling somewhere unfamiliar.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
Pass only on the right.
Watch for oncoming traffic.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before you pass, check that the passing lane is clear and use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Low clearance.
Fines double in a work zone.
No left turn.
Do not block intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign tells you that there is low clearance coming up.

questions.question: Your vehicle's accelerator sticks open while you are driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Blow your horn.
Slam on your brakes.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Turn off your ignition. Be careful not to lock the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off your ignition. Be careful not to lock the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, your vehicle will keep going fast even if you release the gas pedal. Turn off the ignition carefully—only enough to stop the engine without locking the steering wheel. Then apply your brakes and move to a safe area.

questions.question: When you see a steady green arrow on a traffic signal, what can you do?

options.text: Merge into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
Slow down and stop, if it is safe.
Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other vehicles and pedestrians pass.
Drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other vehicles and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you may turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane for the turn. Always let vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which way should you turn your steering wheel?

options.text: Keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
In the opposite direction of the skid.
It does not matter which direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the vehicle to go. When the vehicle starts to straighten out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: Can you legally drive 10 mph over the speed limit?

options.text: Yes, at all times.
Yes, when passing another vehicle.
Yes, in light traffic.
No, never.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, never.
questions.explanation: Speeding is illegal. You must follow the speed limit at all times. You are responsible for knowing the speed limit. The idea that you can drive 10 mph over the limit is not true.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Divided highway ends.
One-way traffic ahead.
Two-way traffic ahead.
Keep to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT help you drive safely at night?

options.text: Keep your windshield clean.
Know that tinted windows reduce visibility in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: If you look at oncoming headlights, your eyes will tighten. After the car passes, your eyes need time to adjust back to the darker light. During this time, you cannot see well—like driving blind.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A dashed white line means you may pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop your vehicle?

options.text: Signal lights.
Other cars on the road.
The time of day.
The condition of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The condition of the road.
questions.explanation: Road conditions affect your ability to stop. Slow down when roads are wet, icy, or in poor condition. Driving too fast on slippery roads makes it hard to stop and control your vehicle.

questions.question: When passing a large vehicle, what should the driver of a small vehicle be prepared for?

options.text: Loud noises.
Excess air pollution.
Strong wind gusts from the large vehicle.
Falling vehicle parts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Strong wind gusts from the large vehicle.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles create strong wind gusts that can push a small car to the side. Be ready to steer and control your vehicle when passing or approaching large vehicles.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The fastest or slowest legal speed you can drive on a road in dangerous conditions.
The fastest or slowest legal speed you can drive on a road in ideal conditions.
The recommended speed to drive on a road in ideal conditions.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest or slowest legal speed you can drive on a road in ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the fastest or slowest legal speed for ideal conditions. You can drive slower than the posted speed, but not faster. Drive slower in school zones, work zones, or when weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What effect does drinking coffee have after drinking alcohol?

options.text: It lowers your blood alcohol level.
It removes the effects of alcohol.
It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
It raises your blood alcohol level.

questions.correctAnswerText: It has no effect on your blood alcohol level.
questions.explanation: Coffee cannot lower your blood alcohol level. While it may keep you awake, it cannot make you sober or change how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No U-turn.
No left turn.
No right turn.
No turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: On a road with no sidewalk, where should a pedestrian walk?

options.text: On the side with the least traffic.
On the same side as traffic flow.
On the side facing oncoming traffic.
On the side with the most traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: On the side facing oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Walk on the side of the road facing the traffic nearest you. This lets you see oncoming vehicles.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow arrow traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into the lane in the direction of the arrow.
Come to a complete stop.
Turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Turn left because you have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow means left turns are permitted in the direction of the arrow. However, oncoming traffic has a green light, so you must let them pass first and watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Upcoming intersections.
Road construction.
The road ahead curves to the right.
Changes in traffic lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What is the first step when parallel parking between two cars?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up even with the car in front of the parking space.
Back slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of the parking space.
questions.explanation: After you find a space, check traffic, and signal, position your car next to the front car. Then turn your wheel to park.
